policy_title: Invest £1.1 Billion in Green Industries Growth Accelerator
stated: The Conservative Party will invest £1.1 billion into the Green Industries Growth Accelerator to support British manufacturing capabilities, boost supply chains, and ensure the energy transition is made in Britain.

source.quote: Invest £1.1 billion into the Green Industries Growth Accelerator to support British manufacturing capabilities, boost supply chains and ensure our energy transition is made in Britain.

bearing_set.reason: Explicitly targets British manufacturing capacity and supply chains in green industries, directly affecting job creation, employment quality, and wages in those sectors.
Directly funds the domestic green energy transition supply chain, materially affecting the pace and credibility of the UK's emissions reduction pathway.
Investing £1.1bn in a fast-growing global sector to build domestic industrial capacity directly targets productivity, business investment, and economic opportunity at the aggregate/supply-side level.
£1.1bn of public expenditure is a material fiscal commitment; whether it is funded, borrowed, or classified as investment affects debt-path sustainability and earns a real verdict here.

membership_note: Four fundamentals earn real verdicts: O6 (energy-transition capacity), O4 (manufacturing job quality), O13 (aggregate industrial/supply-side opportunity), and O12 (fiscal cost of the spending). Effects on O2 (consumer energy prices) and O14 (regional inequality) are plausible but too indirect and mechanism-thin to clear the non-negligible bar at this stage.
